name: What is the best time of year to paint a garage in the Denver metro area?

mainEntity.name: What is the best time of year to paint a garage in the Denver metro area?

acceptedAnswer.text: In the greater Denver and Aurora area, garage painting is ideal during spring, summer, and early autumn when temperatures stay consistently above 50 degrees Fahrenheit. Standard interior latex paints and concrete coatings require moderate temperatures and low humidity to cure properly. While an attached garage provides shelter, unheated garages can experience sharp drops in overnight temperature along the Front Range. If you schedule a winter garage remodel, temporary heating may be necessary to ensure primers and paint set without bubbling or failing.
acceptedAnswer.description: Spring through early fall is ideal. Painting requires temperatures above 50°F to cure properly, which unheated Front Range garages lack in winter without supplemental heat.
